{{Quote|Direct hit.|The gunnery officer, to Gideon|<ref name="Chapter 14" />}}
A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''gunnery officer''' served in [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]'s [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], operating aboard [[Gideon's light cruiser]]. When the [[cruiser]] destroyed the [[gunship]] ''[[Razor Crest]]'' on the [[planet]] [[Tython]] in [[9 ABY]], the [[gunnery officer]] reported a direct hit to Gideon. He later followed [[Elia Kane]] to alert Gideon to a message from the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]]. When Djarin's allies boarded the cruiser, Gideon had the gunnery officer activate the [[Phase-III Dark Trooper|dark troopers]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Activate the dark troopers.|Gideon, to the gunnery officer|<ref name="Chapter 16">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 16: The Rescue}}</ref>}}
During the [[New Republic]]'s [[New Republic Era|reign]], the [[gunnery officer]] served in a [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]], holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]]. [[Gender|He]] served on a [[Gideon's light cruiser]]<ref name="Chapter 14" /> in [[9 ABY]]<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|S2|the appearance of the gunnery [[officer]]}}</ref> and was stationed at the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the [[cruiser]] when it traveled to the [[planet]] [[Tython]] while tracking the [[gunship]] ''[[Razor Crest]]''. After Gideon's ground forces, hunting the [[Force-sensitive]] infant [[Din Grogu|Grogu]], the [[light cruiser]] fired on the ''Razor Crest'', obliterating the [[starship]]. At the cruiser's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], the gunnery [[Imperial officer|officer]] confirmed to Gideon that it had been a direct hit on the ''Crest'', and the moff had some [[Phase-III Dark Trooper|dark troopers]] deploy to apprehend the infant.<ref name="Chapter 14" />

[[File:Message-for-Gideon-CH15.png|thumb|left|300px|The gunnery officer (left) was present for Din Djarin's message to Gideon.]]
The dark troopers successfully captured Grogu, and the cruiser promptly escaped into [[hyperspace]].<ref name="Chapter 14" /> Later, the gunnery [[officer]] followed [[Elia Kane]] into the bridge to inform Gideon of a message from the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]], who intended to take Grogu back from Gideon. The two officers stood beside a table as it displayed the [[Hologram|holographic]] message from the Mandalorian.<ref name="Chapter 15">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 15: The Believer}}</ref> Sometime later, an Imperial [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Operating number|designated]] [[Shuttle 2743]] arrived out of hyperspace near Gideon's cruiser, pursued by the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|''Firespray''-31-class patrol and attack craft]] ''[[Slave I]]''. The cruiser was force to take aboard the [[shuttle]], and the ''Slave I'' escaped into hyperspace. An infiltration team comprised of Djarin's allies then exited the shuttle and [[Second rescue of Grogu|attacked]] the personnel in the hanger.<ref name="Chapter 16" />

The bridge crew listened to the fighting over the comms, and Gideon ordered the dark troopers to be activated. The gunnery officer carried this out, using one of his [[code cylinder]]s to access his terminal to activate the troopers. Gideon departed the bridge, and Djarin's allies soon stormed the bridge. The infiltrators massacred the defending [[stormtrooper]]s and officers present there.<ref name="Chapter 16" />

==Personality and traits==
The gunnery officer was a [[human]] male with [[Color|light]] skin, brown [[hair]] and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="Chapter 15" />

==Equipment==
The gunnery officer [[Clothing|wore]] the standard [[Imperial officer's uniform|uniform]] of an Imperial naval officer, including an [[Imperial kepi]] and two [[code cylinder]]s attached below each shoulder, one of which he used to access his terminal. He wore a [[rank insignia plaque]] on his left [[breast]] with two red bars above two blue,<ref name="Chapter 14" /> which signified the rank of lieutenant.<ref name="Spark">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The officer first appeared in "[[Chapter 14: The Tragedy]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Robert Rodriguez]]<ref name="Chapter 14" /> and released on [[December 4]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-december-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in December 2020}}</ref> Credited as "Gunnery Officer", he was played by [[Gabriel Ebert]].<ref name="Chapter 14" />
